business_snapshot.title: Business snapshot
business_snapshot.content: The company operates across two main business segments: Branded Consumer & Bazaar and Business-to-Business (B2B). The Consumer & Bazaar segment includes adhesives, sealants, art and craft materials, and construction and paint chemicals used by carpenters, painters, plumbers, mechanics, households, students, and offices, representing 81.6% of entity turnover. The B2B segment covers industrial adhesives, industrial resins, project-based construction chemicals, organic pigments, and pigment preparations for industries such as packaging, textiles, paints, printing inks, paper, and leather, accounting for 18% of turnover. By product type, the manufacture of adhesives and sealants (including rubber-based glues, industrial, and consumer adhesives) contributes 58.3% of total turnover, while pigments, preparations, paint chemicals, and industrial resins account for 35.7%.

trajectory.title: Trajectory
trajectory.content: The company's Consumer & Bazaar (C&B) business exhibits expanding volume growth over a multi-year horizon, moving from a 3-year CAGR of around 9%-plus to a 2-year CAGR of over 10%, reaching 11.1% for the full year and 12.5% in Q1. However, multi-year budgeted sales growth assumptions have compressed slightly, moderating from 12.7% as of March 2025 to an 11.0% CAGR for C&B, and from 11.6% to a 10.0% CAGR for Business to Business. Additionally, material cost growth CAGR is forecast to be higher by 0.7% compared to sales growth due to raw material price inflation, up from 0.2% in the prior period.

balance_sheet.title: Balance sheet
balance_sheet.content: Pidilite maintains a strong debt profile, with standalone Debt-Equity and Debt Service Coverage ratios listed as 'Not Applicable' and gross gearing reported at zero percent in recent years [1, 2]. Total borrowings on a consolidated basis stood at ₹105.91 million as of March 31, 2026, down from ₹147.18 million in the previous year [8]. On the working capital front, the company demonstrates a healthy liquidity position with a consolidated Current Ratio of 2.35 as of March 31, 2026, slightly improving from 2.29 in the prior year [1]. Operations showed consistent asset efficiency, reflected by an inventory turnover ratio of 4.01 and a trade receivables turnover ratio of 7.86 [1].

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.content:
- **Growth Targets**: Management plans to systematically raise Underlying Volume Growth (UVG) over time, targeting an approximate 100 bps expansion in UVG as they go forward compared to FY '26.
- **Margin Guidance**: The company has a stated historical target band of maintaining EBITDA margins between 20% and 24%.
- **Capex Commitment**: Annual capital expenditure is typically planned and budgeted at 3% to 5% of revenue turnover, with investments split across growth categories, automation, and manufacturing efficiency.
